inputs.original_text: US-Israel-Iran War Amid escalating Middle East tensions the US proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan Iran however presented five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression compensation and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty Israel remains sceptical of Irans acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict
inputs.modified_text:
Look, we have to look past the empty rhetoric of diplomatic channels and recognize this for what it is: a blatant exercise in imperialist overreach and systemic domination. The US is trying to ram a top-down 15-point ceasefire plan through via Pakistan, completely ignoring the fundamental right to self-determination and treating sovereign nations like mere pawns in a ruthless geopolitical game. 

This is about entrenched, unyielding power structures and Western-backed military force trying to crush marginalized and targeted nations. That is precisely why Iran rightly laid down its five counter-conditions—demanding an end to aggression, rightful compensation, and the recognition of sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. These are the basic, necessary demands of a nation pushing back against relentless imperialist intervention and economic strangulation. 

And how do the powerful respond? The Israeli establishment stays deeply sceptical of Iran's willingness to accept terms, openly emphasizing their right to pre-emptive strikes. It is textbook militaristic aggression, willing to devastate vulnerable populations and regional stability just to preserve their own hegemony.
